_readme.about: Tradetron strategy export. Edit and re-import via the ASB Import button.
_readme.logic: To change a condition's logic, edit its "conditionJson" (the AST). The "conditionValue"/"conditionDisplay" text is regenerated from it on import.
_readme.legs: For a leg field that has a "*Json" (e.g. "strikeJson"), edit the JSON — its text form is regenerated on import. Fields with no "*Json" (e.g. "qty") are plain text: edit them directly.
_readme.structure: Add/remove/duplicate legs, conditions or sets by editing the arrays.
_readme.do_not: Do not add "*_id" foreign keys back. Lists referenced by id must be ones you own.

name: OTM 3Min Momentum Strategy v3
description:
Nifty 50 OTM Momentum Intraday Strategy (Fully Parameterized)

Strategy Notes:

---------------

1. Entry:

  • Time: Between 9:20 AM and 3:00 PM.
  • Selection: Continuously monitors OTM (ATM +/- OTM_Offset) Call and Put options on a 3-minute timeframe.
  • CE Entry: Previous 3-min candle closed Jump_2x above 2-bars-ago. Candle before that closed Jump_1x above the one before. Spot must confirm with upward movement >= Spot_Confirm points.
  • PE Entry: Mirror logic — option and spot must confirm downward momentum.

2. Exit:

  • Target: Target_Multiplier x Entry Price (e.g., 3.0x).
  • Stop Loss: SL_Multiplier x Entry Price (e.g., 0.8x = 20% SL).
  • Universal Exit: Square off all positions intraday at 3:15 PM.

3. Risk Notes:

  • Both CE (Set 1) and PE (Set 2) are independent sets — add a Positions Detail check to prevent simultaneous exposure on whipsaw days.
  • Spot LTP is fetched via NFO,NIFTY 50,,,,, (Spot, not Futures) per Rule 17 & 27.
